program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),   # gm/Id, bottom devices (sets Vdsat_b)
    "gmid_c": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),   # gm/Id, cascode devices (sets Vdsat_c)
    "L":      (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),      # common channel length [um] for ro/gain
    "nA":     (0.12, 0.09, 0.22),   # bottom headroom target = reference-bottom Vds [V]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    Iin = spec["iin"]
    L = p["L"]
    nA = p["nA"]
    VDD = 1.8

    # Output bottom device, sized for full Iin. Its gate node gb sets the bias.
    bo = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], L, Iin, vds=nA)

    # Min-width diode M3 at gb carries a small bleed current I_bd from iin via R.
    # Same gb voltage as bo at the same gm/Id and L.
    I_bd = lut.op("n", 0.42, L, bo.vgs, bo.vgs)["Id"]
    I_ref = Iin - I_bd                      # current actually in the reference stack

    # Reference bottom and both cascodes, sized consistently with the bleed.
    br = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], L, I_ref, vds=nA)   # reference bottom
    cr = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], L, I_ref, vds=0.6)  # reference cascode (diode)
    co = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], L, Iin, vds=0.6)    # output cascode

    # Self-bias: iin = Vgs_cr + nA, and the drop across R equals iin - gb.
    v_iin = cr.vgs + nA
    R = (v_iin - bo.vgs) / I_bd
    R = min(max(R, 1e3), 1e9)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.dev("M1", "iin", "iin", "na", "vss", cr)        # ref cascode, diode-connected
    n.dev("M2", "na", "gb", "vss", "vss", br)         # ref bottom, carries I_ref
    n.M("M3", "gb", "gb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, L)  # bias diode, min width
    n.R("R1", "iin", "gb", R)                         # bleed: sets cascode gate
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "nb", "vss", co)       # output cascode
    n.dev("M5", "nb", "gb", "vss", "vss", bo)         # output bottom, carries Iin

    # Analytic predictions
    nB = v_iin - co.vgs                               # output-bottom Vds (≈ nA)
    dV = abs(nB - nA)                                 # Vds mismatch of the bottoms
    err_pct = 100.0 * bo.gds * dV / Iin               # residual current error
    rout = (co.gm / co.gds) / bo.gds                  # ≈ gm_c·ro_c·ro_b
    v_comp = max(nB, bo.vdsat) + co.vdsat             # lowest Vout keeping saturation
    power = VDD * Iin

    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": err_pct,
        "rout": rout,
        "v_compliance": v_comp,
        "power": power,
    }
